title: arnica alpina var. ungavensis
intro: Arnica alpina var. ungavensis, commonly known as Ungava arnica or mountain arnica, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the Arnica plant, native to the Ungava Peninsula in Quebec, Canada. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Arnica alpina var. ungavensis are attributed to its ability to inhibit prostaglandins, reduce inflammation, and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
